propositions: Local-only git call sites in rebar experience unbounded contention on shared .git locks (index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) under high concurrent agent load, surfacing errors instead of absorbing transient conflicts.

A per-store advisory lock plus jittered bounded retry on git's lock signatures must automatically serialize rebar's writers and handle transient conflicts silently, surfacing only a single actionable error naming the lock file and holder guidance when the bounded budget is exhausted.

Every local-only git call site must be bounded with a watchdog timeout (120-300s per site, justified against local latency not network values) or explicitly documented as deliberately unbounded with reasoning.

Jitter must be applied uniformly [0.75, 1.25] to all deliberate retry sleeps in the store-lock and git-lock contention paths to de-synchronize competing agent processes and prevent thundering-herd behavior.

An age ceiling (e.g., 1 hour) must backstop the refuse-without-proof reclamation branches to prevent permanent store wedges when stamp parsing fails or hostname changes occur (e.g., container recreation).
Uncontended store git writes must add no latency on the happy path: the advisory lock must be non-blocking when uncontended, and no sleep must fire when the lock is immediately available.
